motion: 23, Motion 6 of the plan: the rest of Part 6, five gathered values in their gathered words

pairs.new:
a same-existing-society discovering geodesic.

Humpback whales of the east Australian coast sing a song; in one season 2 of 82 singers are singing a new song nearly the same as the west Australian whales' song, the next season most of 112 singers are singing the old or the new and three a song mixing both, and in under two years the new song alone is sounding. Across six Pacific populations over a decade, songs pass almost always eastward, once westward, from the east Australian population toward French Polynesia over about two years, a new song typically becoming dominant within one breeding season; most songs blend the past year's material with new material, occasionally a completely new song, and how songs pass between populations, by a few males moving or by whales hearing songs while swimming together on migration, is a suspicion still to observe. A mother and her fetus are a same-existing-society of two at a placenta: the mother's KIR receptors and the fetus's trophoblast HLA-C go with how far the mother's spiral arteries remodel into the placenta's blood supply, the layer between them forms from cells fusing by the mammal's own syncytin genes, and cells may pass between them, male cells going on in some women's brains for several decades.
pairs.observes: humpback song passing between societies, and a mother and her fetus, a same-existing-society of two

pairs.old: A voyaging people's orienting is in no self alone:
pairs.new:
Within one body a same-existing-society discovers: nearly each cell with a nucleus shows pieces of its own making on its surface, a passing cytotoxic T cell whose receptor matches a foreign piece recognizes and kills that cell, and among B cells competing in a germinal centre, higher-affinity antibodies to a shape new to the body arise over time, in no cell alone. A Hawaiian bobtail squid hatches with no bacteria, and from a sea full of other microbes its light organ comes to live with Aliivibrio fischeri; the bacteria sense their own density by quorum sensing, each making and sensing a small molecule, a bright glow coming at high density and a dimmer light at a density between low and high; each dawn the squid vents some 90 to 95 percent of them, and the remaining 5 to 10 percent re-form the society before the next night; the glow matches the light striking the squid from above and hides its silhouette from below, a squid and its bacteria orienting as one same-existing-society, the matching of the light above one parity among the many a squid and its bacteria are co-competencing, a dawn's venting and the bacteria's own density among them.

Bats leaving a roost the form of a corridor together, in a model by Mazar and Yovel that has each bat parting its own echoes from the others': with 100 bats about 50 percent of a bat's echoes from a wall a metre off go missing in the others' calls at each call, and still a bat goes on by gathering echoes across several calls, at 40 bats coming out about 20 times in 100 with one call's echoes and about 87 with ten; the model leaves out a bat hearing the others' echoes and following the bats around it, and its authors expect real bats to go on better. No one call is whole, and a sequence of calls goes closer to whole: a co-sequencing of many partial echoes in place of one whole signal.

A voyaging people's orienting is in no self alone:
pairs.observes: a body's cells, a squid and its bacteria, and bats, each an orienting surface in no self alone, before 6.7's closing paragraph
